title: Skin Envelope
description: Extracted from L1_SKIN §2. Every delta at intake is wrapped per this schema. 7 fields normative; 8th field is payload.

sender_token.description: Operator-token from L1_SKIN §4 handshake. MUST match active token.

payload_shape.description: Recognized payload shape category (extensible per L1_SCHEMA).

causal_parent_ref.description: Prior sporocarp ID, or null at first delta after handshake. Non-null MUST refer to a recent sporocarp in the most-recent digest.

size_bytes.description: Delta size in bytes. MUST be ≤ L1-tunable (default 100 MB).

submitted_at_cycle.description: Substrate metabolic-cycle counter at submission. MUST be within freshness window (default 60 cycles, per L0 §13.1).

envelope_digest.description: HMAC(operator_token, canonical_envelope_fields || payload). Recomputed on intake.

payload.description: Delta content. Substrate validates envelope only (I8 + P2 shape-agnostic).
